facebook.content:
When you're walking in your purpose, you'll be in a state of perpetual obedience, not constant decision-making. Think about it, when you're doing what God created you to do, you won't be wondering if God wants you to take this job or be with that person.

You won't be in a state of questioning, because your actions will be a reflection of God's will. "For to be carnally minded is death, but to be spiritually minded is life and peace." - Romans 8:6

instagram.content:
Your Marriage is Not Your Husband's Problem

In Genesis 2:24, God says, "Therefore a man shall leave his father and mother and hold fast to his wife, and they shall become one flesh." It doesn't say "fix my husband" or "change him." Your marriage is between you and God first. 

Who are you trying to fix?

Double tap if you've realized the power of your own responsibility in your marriage!
